title: MIMO + Mirror member diversity
hypothesis: On a controlled nonlinear classification problem, a shared MIMO trunk with one learned scalar Mirror coordinate per member can reduce member correlation and improve ensemble NLL over native MIMO while using fewer actual bytes than member-specific readout heads and preserving one shared-trunk evaluation.
physical_object: one shared 2-layer MLP trunk plus readout state for four members
mirror_coordinate: one learned scalar per member selecting a linear combination of two readout basis matrices
logical_multiplicity: four independently supervised member classifiers evaluated from one shared trunk
controls: shared trunk with four native MIMO heads
rank-1 readout basis with ordinary scalar member coefficients
same rank-1 readout basis with Mirror scalar coordinates
rank-2 readout basis with direct coefficients

development.selection_metric: pooled ensemble NLL; member correctness correlation; pairwise Jensen-Shannon diversity; member accuracy and calibration; actual serialized bytes; MAC proxy and wall time
development.architecture: 2D input, four deterministic angular-sector classes, MLP hidden widths [32,32], ReLU, four members

storage.authority: actual deterministic ZIP/NPY inference payload bytes after reload
paid_objects: readout basis or native member heads
all member scalar codes or direct coefficients

success_gate: Both development worlds: Mirror pooled NLL within 0.01 of native MIMO, pairwise correctness correlation at least 0.05 lower, actual payload at least 10% smaller, compute <=1.10x; direct coefficients must be >=10% larger at equal quality for a Mirror-specific pass.
failure_gate: Either development world has Mirror NLL > native MIMO by 0.03, or payload saving <10%, correlation gain <0.05, direct coefficients within 10% at equal quality, or compute >1.10x; seal fresh.
amendment: Initial development attempt produced uniform four-class predictions in shared-readout methods (NLL approximately ln(4)) and exposed a label-indexing error in the independent upper control. No fresh seeds were accessed. Before any fresh/audit data, amend the synthetic task to deterministic angular sectors and train all members on the same labels/examples so native MIMO/shared-readout optimization is diagnostically valid. Same architecture widths, updates, optimizer, seeds, payload contract and gates; rerun development seeds from scratch. Archive invalid exploratory output and do not include it as evidence.
boundaries: synthetic fixed-budget mechanism screen, not near-converged capacity evidence
MIMO is represented by jointly supervised member outputs sharing a hidden trunk
no language modeling or natural-data claim
